verdict.rationale: Entra ID documents automatic SCIM provisioning of users and groups into SaaS apps like Dropbox, Salesforce and ServiceNow, plus on-premises apps and a gallery of SCIM-enabled apps. Entitlement Management access-package assignment shows the access-assignment side, but the docs never tie it directly to downstream pushes. Missing for 10: evidence that entitlements/app roles (not just users and groups) are pushed, evidence on provisioning timing (immediate on assignment vs. scheduled sync cycles), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
